scope: Current working-tree contracts; source tests do not attest installed or hosted releases
verified_scope: The verified list names bounded fixtures, not complete platform/client or production acceptance.

runtime_contracts.name: Policy cache
runtime_contracts.limit: Not encrypted or hardware-rooted; same-user trust-pin/state tampering remains a limitation

runtime_contracts.name: Policy freshness
runtime_contracts.status: Three-second polling in watcher and current-source daemon
runtime_contracts.limit: Not an end-to-end SLA; offline or unauthenticated clients cannot receive immediate revocation

runtime_contracts.name: Prompt fallback
runtime_contracts.status: Hooks-first session/turn arbitration implemented in working tree
runtime_contracts.limit: MCP reports are cooperative/self-reported; exact cross-source correlation needs shared native turn IDs; matching rollout required

runtime_contracts.name: Legacy execution
runtime_contracts.status: Parser-based checks and platform-specific child execution
runtime_contracts.limit: Not host-wide interception or the same boundary as native run

runtime_contracts.name: Native capability authority
runtime_contracts.status: Grant converter and runner profiles implemented separately
runtime_contracts.limit: Effect-level Set is not the active grant-to-runner authority path

runtime_contracts.name: Persistence
runtime_contracts.limit: Requires qualified persistent deployment storage; multi-replica authority and distributed consumption unqualified

runtime_contracts.name: Audit evidence
runtime_contracts.limit: Not proof of completeness, independent notarization, productivity or compliance certification

runtime_contracts.name: Privacy
runtime_contracts.status: Generic metadata minimization with a separate signed prompt-capture setting
runtime_contracts.limit: Prompt capture defaults to required; no zero-code-exfiltration or all-producer DLP guarantee
